author: Guuzzeji
summary: Resolved the full Mnemo design through review: EmbeddingGemma 300M ONNX via hugot pure-Go (768-dim, zero CGO), local SQLite vec0 index via modernc.org/sqlite/vec (exact-scan cosine), UUIDv7 log IDs with git-author attribution, position-based delta sync, four MCP tools.
reasoning: Design review of project-idea.md proved LiteRT-LM unusable from Go (prebuilt C API exports zero embedding symbols, no Go bindings, no ungated official model), sqlite-vector license-blocked (Elastic 2.0 modified) with no Go bindings, and Turso dropped for cloud dependency. Pivoted fully local: EmbeddingGemma ONNX from ungated onnx-community mirror, hugot pure-Go backend, modernc.org/sqlite/vec, gitignored local DB rebuilt from JSONL log after git pull.

author: Guuzzeji
summary: EmbeddingGemma 300M ONNX with gomlx/hugot: use fp32 model.onnx or model_quantized.onnx (int8+DequantizeLinear), NOT q4/fp16 variants. External data file must sit next to .onnx with exact name from graph (hugot sets WithBaseDir(model.Path)).
reasoning: onnx-gomlx supports external data via FilesReader (filepath.Join(baseDir, location)) and hugot calls WithBaseDir(model.Path) so model.onnx_data must be in same dir with exact graph-referenced name. q4 variants use MatMulNBits/GatherBlockQuantized/INT4 ops+dtype NOT in onnx-gomlx (dtypeForONNX has no INT4; janpfeifer confirmed no 4-bit in GoMLX). fp16 variant officially unsupported by model authors (activations overflow) and mixes FLOAT16/FLOAT without AllowDTypePromotion. model_quantized.onnx uses DequantizeLinear+INT8 (supported) with all-FLOAT compute. fp32 model.onnx ops all supported (RotaryEmbedding/MultiHeadAttention/SimplifiedLayerNormalization implemented for HF optimum export format).

author: Guuzzeji
summary: Fixed embedding model download: correct HF paths (onnx/model.onnx + onnx/model.onnx_data + tokenizer.json + config.json) and model dir creation. Server now loads the model, syncs, and semantic_search works.
reasoning: First boot failed with HTTP 404 because the downloader used the wrong HF path (repo-root model.onnx instead of onnx/model.onnx) and fetched only 1 of the 4 files embed.go requires. Fixed by downloading all four files (onnx/model.onnx, onnx/model.onnx_data, tokenizer.json, config.json) and MkdirAll-ing the model dir. Also materialized the orphaned embeddinggemma-onnx-gomlx doc that a subagent had logged without creating, which broke startup sync.

author: Guuzzeji
summary: Restructured repo for public release: main.go moved to repo root, module renamed to github.com/Guuzzeji/ai-shared-memory, binary now lives at .memory-mcp/mnemo (gitignored), agent docs uppercased (AGENT-SETUP.md/AGENT-TEMPLATE.md), added CI + goreleaser release workflows, gitignore covers index.db-shm/wal sidecars and .sisyphus/
reasoning: Public-readiness pass: module path must match repo name so go install resolves; SQLite WAL sidecars and orchestration artifacts (.sisyphus/) must never be committed; machine-specific .mcp.json/opencode.json are gitignored with .example files committed instead; root main package means go install yields binary 'ai-shared-memory' (docs recommend go build -o .memory-mcp/mnemo . for the 'mnemo' name)

author: Guuzzeji
summary: Added reindex MCP tool so the AI agent can trigger a full index rebuild itself (wipe + replay log), matching the CLI --reindex flag
reasoning: Previously only a human could run --reindex via CLI. The agent now has a self-service path when the index is stale, corrupted, or built with a different embedding model. Thin wrapper over the existing Syncer.Reindex; returns indexed_docs count; errors with 'index unavailable' in degraded mode.
